report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency degradation, but current telemetry is healthy: all services show error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, and the single order trace is OK at 1050ms. Order shows elevated retained memory (260MB, retained_after_gc) with WARN logs, but a short increase alone cannot establish a leak, and no latency/error link is observed. Insufficient evidence for any bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Current error-rate/latency metrics showing the alert condition (all services report error_rate 0.001 and p95 72ms)
Order service p95 latency and error counts over the alert window
Sustained memory-retention time series for order to distinguish leak from transient retention
Heap/GC profile or allocation breakdown for order service
Deployment records for order service around the incident window
